title: Greatest English Letter in Upper and Lower Case
summary: Given a string of English letters, find the greatest letter that appears both in uppercase and lowercase.
statement: Given a string of English letters, find the greatest letter that appears both in uppercase and lowercase. Return the uppercase form of this letter. If no such letter exists, return an empty string. The comparison is based on the English alphabet order.
constraints: A letter qualifies only when both its uppercase and lowercase forms occur.
Return the alphabetically greatest qualifying uppercase letter, or an empty string if none qualifies.
hints: Put every character in a set.
Inspect uppercase letters from Z down to A.
Return the first letter whose uppercase and lowercase forms are both present.
Descending inspection makes the first qualifying letter exactly the greatest one.
editorial: Descending inspection makes the first qualifying letter exactly the greatest one.

tests.explanation: E is the greatest letter appearing in both cases.
No letter appears in both cases, so the result is empty.
